shape: HCI coursework in markdown: a five-person think-aloud test with a small table of text results (task, what happened, main problem).
tests: A table graph from text results: the headings come first, each row keeps its own task, and no figures are invented to make a bar chart.

keyFacts.fact: Find which steps of the library's room booking page people get stuck on.
Five students who had never booked a room did three tasks while thinking aloud.
Three of five booked one hour by mistake because the length defaults to one hour.
Two of five gave up cancelling: Cancel is under My account.
Recommended moving the room list above the map, a required length choice and a Cancel button on each booking.
